text:
jess-cs: Heads-up — QuantifyX reached out: they need a high-precision extractor for legal + finance docs. Entities: SSNs, bank acct numbers, case IDs, and court judgments. They require private deployment, HSM for keys, and 1y audit log retention. Asked for eval plan + a timeline.

sam-ml: Good to know. Do they have labeled data and OCR quality details? sequence lengths?

jess-cs: Customer note (redacted):

    "~12k contracts + 40k scanned invoices (mixed OCR). We'll label 2k samples initially. Require >=95% recall on SSNs and <0.5% FP for masked PHI. Contract clause: no model retention of raw text."

olivia-se: Suggested approach: 1) data intake to profile OCR noise, 2) augment + finetune a 7B-class model with PII-aware augmentation, 3) safety eval + regex-backed post-filter. Recommend Private (HSM) but do a Dedicated canary first.

sam-ml: For evals: precision/recall per-entity, token-F1, and adversarial redaction tests. Proposed pass thresholds: SSN recall >=95%, SSN precision >=99%, overall F1 >=0.88. Need counts for positives/negatives per entity.

marco-ps: I'll schedule customer kickoff next Wed. Who picks up HSM integration checklist?

mia-legal: I'll own the legal checklist and contract addendum (HSM + no-model-retention). Need their DPA and SOC docs; also a minimal data flow map for cross-border review.

jess-cs: @sam-ml @olivia-se can you confirm model family and rough compute for a PoC? Customer wants timeline in 3 business days.

sam-ml: PoC plan: custom 7B (quantized q4) fine-tune on 2k labeled samples, 2-3 epochs. Estimate ~24 GPU-hours for tuning on A100 equiv, plus 8-12 GPU-hours for eval and stress tests. Dedicated canary adds ~24-48h for infra setup.

olivia-se: Proposal snippet for ops: 

    deployment:
      mode: private
      model: custom-7b-finetuned
      quantization: q4_0
      kms: awskms://alias/quantifyx
      hsm_provisioned: true
      audit_log_retention_days: 365
      canary: dedicated-us-west-2

sam-ml: Also note: disable prefix caching for sensitive routes or ensure encryption-at-rest for caches. Must not persist raw inference payloads in logs.

marco-ps: Created ticket CS-5891 for onboarding tasks and EVAL-221 for the evaluation pipeline. deploy-bot: ticket CS-5891 created by marco-ps.

jess-cs: Timeline to customer: kickoff in 48-72h, 2-week PoC (labeling + tuning + eval), then ~2 weeks for security & legal review for Private. Target ~4-5 weeks to full private rollout if no blockers.

mia-legal: I'll request their DPA, SOC, and a data map before private go-live. Also flag any cross-border hosting constraints.

sam-ml: Next ML steps: send labeling spec + small notebook for tokenization/OCR cleaning. I'll add a test harness for adversarial redaction evals.

jess-cs: I'll reply to QuantifyX with that timeline and attach the kickoff survey + labeling spec. Tagging owners: @sam-ml @olivia-se @mia-legal. :thumbsup:

marco-ps: I'll book the kickoff and loop infra + solutions.

olivia-se: Suggest adding a manual review queue in their annotator UI for low-confidence PII hits to reduce false positives during rollout.

sam-ml: We'll implement a confidence-threshold hook + explainability tokens for the review queue.

jess-cs: Thanks all — will update after kickoff call.
